masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: After Foundations, one branch and Conversation Lab, you can follow a full game with a fan, decode the common lines ("they're in the bonus", "he can't shoot", "we're in the Play-In"), and ask a genuine follow-up about their team without pretending to be an expert.

licensingConstraints.constraint: No NBA, WNBA, NCAA or team logos or branded assets; league and team names as text only (nominative use); "March Madness" is an NCAA trademark pending legal review, use "NCAA tournament" in chrome.
No player photos, illustrations or animation of real players; sims use anonymous stylized figures; player names appear as text only.
All images are original (procedural diagrams, original referee-signal illustrations with license id swoond-original-illustration); no press or unlicensed photos.
No game footage or highlights embedded; deep-link out only.
No licensed audio; no listening-id exercises; sim cues are original synthesized sounds.
Never copy publisher article text; explain in our own words and link.
Follow each provider's terms and attribute where required; no unofficial or scraped league stats endpoints in production; all data behind Swoon'd adapters.
No betting, odds or sportsbook content or links of any kind.

safetyConstraints: Never teach, promote or link to betting, odds or sportsbooks.
Never gamify injuries, off-court legal matters or player conduct controversies.
Never encourage faking expertise; Talk Tracks reward honest curiosity.
